configuration.catala.enableCustomTestCas: Enable the custom test case editor for Catala test files
configuration.catala-lsp.trace.server.de: Controls the logging output of the language server. Valid settings are `off`, `messages`, or `verbose`.
configuration.catala-lsp.enableProjectSc: Controls whether the LSP server should actively scan through the project to detect dependency breakage. This may be ressource-intensive on large projects. Switching this parameter requires a reload of VSCode to become effective.
configuration.catala.language.descriptio: Language the Catala editors present values in
configuration.catala.language.enumDescri: Let each editor pick, as it did before there was a setting
The language of the file itself, from its .catala_xx suffix
configuration.catala.traceView.function_: Show function call steps in the trace tree. When off, the step is removed and its sub-steps are shown in its place.
configuration.catala.traceView.branch_co: Show branch condition steps in the trace tree. When off, the step is removed and its sub-steps are shown in its place.
configuration.catala.traceView.if_branch: Show if/then/else branching steps in the trace tree. When off, the step is removed and its sub-steps are shown in its place.
configuration.catala.traceView.match_bra: Show pattern-match branching steps in the trace tree. When off, the step is removed and its sub-steps are shown in its place.
configuration.catala.traceView.assertion: Show assertion steps in the trace tree. When off, the step is removed and its sub-steps are shown in its place.
configuration.catala.traceView.exception: Show exception steps in the trace tree. When off, the step is removed and its sub-steps are shown in its place.
configuration.catala.traceView.input_ass: Show the assignment of a scope call's inputs, listed directly under the call. When off, the step is removed and its sub-steps are shown in its place.
configuration.catala.traceView.error.mar: Show error steps in the trace tree. When off, the step is removed and its sub-steps are shown in its place.
